manifest.title: Negotiation Table
manifest.description: Two parties negotiate under the typed bargaining protocol: stated interests, opening proposals, bargaining rounds against a quoted concession ledger, arbitration only if no unanimous agreement is signed, and a final synthesis quoting the ledger. The arbiter must be a deployed AGENT — it moderates the arbitration and synthesis phases. For a human decision-maker in the loop, use the decision-board template (HUMAN roster members) or add hitlConfig approval gates to the instantiated group instead.

requiredRoles.description: Arbitrates if bargaining fails; synthesizes the outcome (must be a deployed agent)

config.name: Negotiation Table
config.description: Typed two-party bargaining with a concession ledger and arbitration fallback
